{{Quote|Trymbo's at his fishing camp. He'll be thrilled to have some company. Now excuse me, dearie&mdash;these Rodian peppers won't cook themselves!|Loonda|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Rodian peppers''' was a type of food that came from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. [[Loonda]] cooked Rodian peppers on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
